report.explanation: All four services show identical healthy latency (p95 72ms), error rate 0.0012, zero dependency timeouts and zero db pool waiters. Order alone reports 300MB retained after GC with 8000 net allocations, but no memory-retention history exists to establish a leak trend, and no latency or error signal corroborates checkout degradation. Insufficient evidence to bound a root cause.
missing_evidence: Chronological memory-retention series for order to establish a sustained growth trend versus a single snapshot
Baseline memory-retention values for gateway, payment and inventory for comparison
Evidence of checkout degradation (elevated latency or error rate) aligned to a specific service
Deployment or configuration change records for the incident window
GC pause or heap utilization metrics for order
